title: Adult & Mental Health Nursing
subject: Nursing & Health
summary: A dual-field nursing degree that qualifies you in both adult and mental health nursing.
description: This course trains you across two fields of nursing, so you can support people's physical and mental health together.
It usually takes a little longer than a single-field degree, but you graduate able to register in both fields with the NMC.
entryRequirements: A-levels, BTEC or an Access to Higher Education Diploma (Level 3)
GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above
Enhanced DBS check and occupational health clearance
